During the [[Xim Wars|conflict]] between the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and the self-declared [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] [[Daritha]] [[Xim/Legends|Xim]], the Hutts reconquered the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Moralan]] during the '''invasion of Moralan''' after the [[Moralan (species)|Moralan]] species who lived there freed themselves from Hutt [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]. [[Boonta Hestilic Shad'ruu/Legends|Boonta Hestilic Shad'ruu]] led the Hutt forces to victory in the battle, and the Moralan's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was sterilized as punishment, leading to the [[Death/Legends|extinction]] of the native species.

==Prelude==
[[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] forces from the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] of the self-declared [[Daritha]]&mdash;an old title used by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] meaning [[Emperor/Legends|emperor]]&mdash;[[Xim/Legends|Xim]] entered the [[Moralan system/Legends|Moralan system]] during the [[Xim Wars|conflict]] between the [[Hutt Empire]] of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and the Tionese<ref name="Xim" /> in the period between [[25,102 BBY]] and [[25,096 BBY]].<ref name="EA30" /> While in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], they encouraged the native [[Moralan (species)|Moralan]] species, who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Moralan|the same name]], to free themselves from their [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].<ref name="Xim" /> The Moralan did so and formed a [[Moralan republic|republic]]<ref name="EA30" /> led by the [[Parliament of Moralan]].<ref name="Droids" /> After the [[Second Battle of Vontor]], in which Xim's forces lost to the Hutts on the planet [[Vontor]], the Tionese withdrew from the Moralan system, leaving the Moralan alone to face their former masters.<ref name="Xim" />

==The battle==
With the Tionese gone, the Hutts returned to the Moralan system<ref name="Xim" /> led by a Hutt named [[Boonta Hestilic Shad'ruu/Legends|Boonta Hestilic Shad'ruu]]. The Hutt forces fought for three [[Standard day/Legends|days]] against the forces of the [[Parliament of Moralan]]<ref name="Droids" /> during the invasion of Moralan<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> eventually emerging victorious over the Moralan.<ref name="Droids" />

==Aftermath==
As punishment for the natives' rebellion, the Moralan [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was sterilized<ref name="Xim" /> and the species driven to extinction.<ref name="EA30" /> Boonta went on to be given control of the Hutt forces against Xim at the [[Third Battle of Vontor]], partially due to his victory at Moralan, and at the battle he defeated Xim for the final [[Time/Legends|time]] as the despot was captured by the Hutts.<ref name="Xim" /> Boonta's victory against the Moralan was later celebrated with a holiday named after him&mdash;[[Boonta Eve/Legends|Boonta's Eve]], which lasted three days, just as the battle had.<ref name="Droids" />

==Behind the scenes==
The invasion of Moralan was first mentioned in an article by [[Rich Handley]] and [[Abel G. Peña]] regarding the [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] television series in the [[Polyhedron 170|170th]] issue of the ''[[Polyhedron]]'' [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] magazine, released in [[June]] [[2004]].<ref name="Droids" />
